recognize_zh: CD34 染色主要標出骨髓中大量微血管與竇狀內皮細胞，箭頭所指是一顆圓形、細胞膜陽性的造血前驅細胞/母細胞，屬於零星存在；表示在細胞增多的骨髓中母細胞並未增加。
features: Strong CD34 staining of capillary and sinusoidal endothelium throughout the marrow
Arrow marks a single round CD34-positive hematopoietic cell with membranous staining
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Hypercellular marrow with numerous CD34-negative hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
Weak non-specific background staining at the upper left edge
describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry of a bone marrow core biopsy shows strong staining of numerous capillaries and sinusoidal endothelial cells, which serve as an internal positive control. Hematopoietic CD34-positive cells are rare; the arrow marks a single round cell with membranous staining, and no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts are identified in the hypercellular marrow. Findings indicate that blasts are not increased, arguing against a myelodysplastic or acute leukemic process, and are compatible with the reactive marrow of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Shows increased CD34-positive blasts (>=5%) often forming small clusters away from bony trabeculae.
CD34-positive blasts form sheets or constitute >=20% of cellularity.
Also shows few CD34-positive cells, but the marrow is markedly hypocellular with fat replacement.
